description: CHG-ESTACK-SEC-QUERIES-001. Typed bind parameters of certified queries for the human-reported evidence route (python -m human_evidence request --param NAME=VALUE). A value is accepted only if it matches its type and range, and is rendered as a literal of that type (integer, TO_DATE timestamp, quoted sql_id or upper-case Oracle name) after the certified SQL was resolved and hash-verified; the rendered SQL passes the read-only guard again. Adding a parameter is a /change security.
